notes.title: Update 3.6!
notes.notes:
Hey there!

This update will add indication of who is talking throughout the game, as well as clean up some more typos that I noticed while doing so.

I did my best to push this through last night but couldn't stay up all night soo, you get it now. 

If you notice any where the text isn't working properly please feel free to either message me or write in the Bugs Discussion, and I'll get back to it after work!

Also I am doing what I can to fix the Achievement problem, so hopefully I will be able to get back to you with another update soon that will fix it.

Thanks for your time and have fun out there!
ːPredatorTheCatː

notes.title: 1166 Has Launched!
notes.notes:
[h1]Hey there![/h1]

It is finally that time! I would like to say thank you all for your support and advice in the creation of 1166. I learned quite a bit along the way and I'm glad that I was able to persist through. I couldn't have done it without the community support. 

If anyone has any questions about 1166 please feel free to message me on steam or contact me at [h1]1166thegame@gmail.com.[/h1]Any criticism is helpful, and I would love to hear your comments!

I will be creating guides on how to beat the game, so if you have any trouble please check it out.

To everyone who has asked me, yes there will be a sequel. If you make it to the end and get the good ending, email me a screenshot and I will send you a little teaser (if you want it).

If anyone had ideas on how to make the game better please contact me and let me know your opinions!

[h1]Again, me and my cats would like to say thank you. You guys keep the dream alive.[/h1]

-Predator Productions ːPredatorTheCatːːLittleRedCatːːLittleBlackCatː

notes.title: 10 Days Until Launch!
notes.notes:
[h1]Hey guys![/h1]

I've been pretty busy fine tuning the game for the past few months with my helpful team of beta testers, and things are looking good. A lot of little bugs (some big ones) and things like dialogue, or graphical errors have been cleaned up to create a better experience. As some of you may know, I am a solo indie developer so to all the people who helped me create this game, I would like to say thank you and I hope you had as much fun as I did.

To all the people looking to give 1166 a shot, please let me know if you find anything at all that "bugs" you about the game and I'll be more than happy to talk to you about it, and do my best to fix it. Feel free to contact me on this account and tell me what's rattling in that head of yours. 

[h1]Thanks again for your love and support.
It's people like you keeping indie devs above water![/h1]

-Predator Productions  :)

notes.title: Update 3.3 Is live!! Achievements!
notes.notes:
For a list of Achievements please view: http://steamcommunity.com/groups/1166BT#announcements/detail/240217512922358721

[h1]Here are the update notes![/h1]
[list]Stability of movement speeds

[*]New art for city sky

[*]Cannot attack in Cop station

[*]Fixed level back loops

[*]Player attacked cleaned up

[*]Various typos

[*]Moms room trigger too large

[*]Dream 2 monsters not facing Alex

[*]Alex Dream 2: moved monsters hit box down to keep them more in hit zone

[*]Can’t talk to Large Monster in Alex dream. Portal location fixed

[*]Panning too fast in after dream Alex's Dream#2

[*]Marble table better hitbox

[*]Fixed barriers in various scenes

[*]As well as some other small things that weren't worth mentioning
[/list]

[h1]Beta will be over in 7 weeks so look forward to the upcoming release!
Thanks for your interest and support!
[/h1]

notes.title: Incoming Achievements! (Update 3.3)
notes.notes:
[h1]Hey there everybody![/h1]

The Achievements Bug has been fixed, which means that the next update will have a set of 23 Achievements (along with many other specific tweaks to the overall game. More info when the update is live.) . Pressing Tab will open the Achievement interface at any point in the game. 

[h1]Here is a list of the different Achievements that will be available![/h1]

 [list]
[*]First Step","The Longest Journey Starts With a Single Step."  

[*]Sympathizer","Talk to a monster...They can't be that bad, right?"  	

[*]Poor Alex","See Alex at her worst."  	

[*]Poor, Poor Alex","See Alex at her worst, twice."  	

[*]Cat Whisperer","Talk to a cat you didn't have to talk to."  	

[*]The Hostel","Defeat the Great Beast in the Hostel Halls. Did you run or did you fight?"  	

[*]Dream Walker","Defeat the Beast that lives in your Dreams. Did you run or fight?"  	

[*]Hell Spawn","Defeat the Beast that stirs in the depths. Did you run or fight?"  	

[*]Smoke and Ash","Discover the Good Ending.  	

[*]Last Rites","Discover the Bad Ending.

[*]Five More Minutes","Discover a Passive Ending.  	

[*]The Sad Truth","Discover the all of the endings."   	

[*]The Elder","Follow the Candle."   	

[*]The Beast","Follow the Cane."  	

[*]The Sacrifice","Follow the Blade."  	

[*]The Abused","Follow the Phone."  	

[*]The Butterfly", "Follow the Cuff."  	

[*]The Punished","Follow the Car." 	

[*]The Fool","Put ??? to Sleep."  	

[*]The Playground","Put Marchosias to Sleep."  	

[*]The Failure","Put Lucas to Sleep."  	

[*]The Tortured","Put Alex to Sleep."  	

[*]The Justifier","Put Amy to Sleep."  	

[*]The Wrathful","Put Daudaz to Sleep." 

[h1]I hope to see you all in game soon!
Have a good day![/h1]

notes.title: 1166 BETA!
notes.notes:
Hey guys!

1166 will be holding a closed beta, and if you are interested please contact me at 1166closedbeta@gmail.com. 

The beta is mostly finished, and I will be polishing up the small details to make the game feel a bit more seamless. If you have a knack for nitpicking, taking notes, and attention to detail then email me.

Otherwise have great day and thanks for stopping by!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27508943/323d34d83c1d6becf5ff53002bcb735e4c0269f4.png[/img]

[h1] UPDATE: The first round of beta testing has filled up[/h1]
If necessary I will open another beta to a slightly larger group in about three to four weeks! If you are sill interested please email me and you will be put in a queue for the next round of beta testing. Thanks for your interest and support!
